scope: Bounded conceptual Chat-sandbox comparison; NOT original TAN/P1-B/v11 or biological replication
keep_eigenvalues: strictly greater than cutoff; no absolute-value inversion of negative modes
fault_scale: delta=ratio*smallest_positive_eigenvalue(C_true_initial); one persistent additive symmetric fault after clean initialization, not reinjected each write

arms.P: old: b0=Qhat b; b <- b0 + (v-x^T Khat b0)*Qhat x
arms.PN: old: b0=Qhat b; ell=x^T Khat x; b <- b0 + (v-x^T Khat b0)/ell * Qhat x
arms.TK: same PN algorithm and same faulty C/cutoff; evaluator supplies noiseless current feature instead of x; no oracle inverse or historical key table

important_convention: P/PN/TK reproject the entire b, not only the increment. This can delete old weak-direction content. TK is a privileged address-control reference, not a universal performance upper bound.
routing: learner uses norm((I-Qhat)x)>tau for new; no operation labels or true IDs are supplied; clean initialization uses tau=1e-9 and cutoff=1e-12, then frozen runtime tau/cutoff
new_write: C <- C+xx^T; b <- b+v*x; increment admission counter; reject new when counter==dimension; no automatic b projection on new branch
rng: none; all vectors and cases deterministic
learner_access: only current observed feature and desired value; C,b,admission counter,cutoff,tau; evaluator alone retains canonical keys/latest targets/reference matrices
measurements: true-key output and max latest error; other-key drift
residual at presented feature and at original noisy feature
norm(b), norm(w), leverage and fixed-C residual recurrence
projector error norm(Qhat-Qtrue), idempotence, retained rank
weak-mode b component and full-reprojection deletion
post-new actual output, old-key protection, intended new admission
gap/cutoff sufficient condition delta<cutoff<alpha-delta; projector bound delta/(alpha-delta) only when certified
claims: descriptive paired deterministic cases; no p-values or population claims; report all failures; do not tune grid from output
predeclared_additional_fixtures: truncate a valid weak direction in diagonal C then remove cutoff to test irreversible content deletion
rotate weak subspace with cos=.8,sin=.6 and alpha=.1; Qhat exactly idempotent yet leaves true-null pollution
two distinct dictionaries with identical C=I_on_span,b=0 and ambiguous span-inside incoming key
exact-Q invariant and new-direction ghost identity checked independently of matrix faults
